text: Ɓen siforiiɓe ɗin sifaaji murtugol ɓaawo nde gomɗinde, ko ɓen Alla noti e ɓerɗe mun ɓe faama- taa waaju, O noti kadi e nanɗe maɓɓe ɗen ɓe nanataa ko ɓe, O noti kadi e gite maɓɓe ɗen ɓe yi'ataa maandeeji tinndinayɗi e gomɗinal ɗin. Ko ɓen woni welsindiiɓe e sabuuji maloore emalki- seede ɗin, e kon ko Alla hebilani ɓe e lepte.
